mass_definition: abs(native vertical G force in kN) * 1000 / 9.80665; total modeled dead load, not native element mass alone or as-built fabrication mass
selection: For each sample independently report five-output Pareto candidates, individual minima, and response reduction (%) per added mass (%) relative to its own P36. Do not assume P37 wins; no capacity safety threshold or universal optimum is asserted.
